notes.title: Fresh challenges and Steam Trading Cards are here!
URBO: Upcoming Update and Fresh Challenges!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're pleased to announce the major update for URBO. Soon our game will delight you with brand new puzzles. Are you ready to join us on this amazing adventure? Here's what lies ahead:

Session Mode
In this game mode, the number of moves is limited. If your goal is to reach the highest possible population, your every move truly counts. Sharpen your skills to become the architect of the most beautiful, prosperous city you can create in the Session Mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166619/bbab8591ac41bb3f2a6a611b4650e31ee36de691.gif

Puzzle Mode
This mode is another fascinating puzzle with pre-set conditions. This time, your goal is to find the right place for each building from the queue to eventually construct a level eight building in the center of an island. You have quite a degree of freedom to get creative here. In Puzzle Mode, there is no restriction on undoing moves. In other words, you can return the island to its initial state and try to solve the puzzle in an entirely different way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166619/13b0fa3f70b7ebd59803273aa3cbd263bbc5e0b5.gif

The upcoming update will vary the gameplay and add depth to it. By removing the element of luck and keeping the core gameplay, we have created a new warm-up for the minds. After all, now puzzles have optimal solutions you have to find. If URBO lacked the feeling of victory, the upcoming update is exactly what you need. Hopefully, with the new game modes, you'll discover your own perfect floating island where you will build the city of your dreams.

Stay tuned, the update is far from release at this moment. But it's definitely worth the wait!
